_comment: Registry of all pre-built section types. Managed via /admin/pages/section-types (read-only view). Adding a new visual renderer requires a code deploy; configuring which types appear on which page does not. dataSource values: 'inline' (content in the composition instance), 'shared:X' (from a shared admin-managed file), 'page:X' (from the page's own marketing content JSON).
